info.title: musickit-sdk-linux engine API
info.description: Local HTTP API of the musickit-sdk-linux engine (`musickit-engine --api <port>`). Served over HTTPS on 127.0.0.1 with a per-run self-signed certificate. Requests must carry a loopback Host; a browser Origin, if present, must be loopback or https://music.apple.com. Stability notes and workflows: docs/api.md.
